Class Colors

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.view.Colors
public class Colors extends Object
Centralized ANSI color constants and colorization utilities for terminal output. This utility class provides a consistent color scheme across the entire Splendor console interface. Each gem type, UI element, and game component has an associated color to improve visual clarity and user experience.

Color assignments:

  • RED, GREEN, BLUE, WHITE, BLACK - Gem colors
  • GOLD - Gold token (wild card) color
  • CYAN - Player names and important information
  • PURPLE - Noble tiles
  • GRAY - Disabled options and secondary information
  • DIM - Unaffordable cards and inaccessible elements

ANSI support is automatically detected at startup via the detectAnsiSupport() method, which checks JVM system properties and environment variables. This ensures compatibility with terminals that don't support ANSI escape codes.

All colorization methods automatically append the RESET code after the colored text to prevent color bleeding into subsequent output.

Usage example: 

  String redText = Colors.colorize("Red Gem", Colors.RED);
  String gemColor = Colors.getGemColor(Gem.BLUE);
See Also:
  • For gem type to color mapping
  • For ANSI-aware string manipulation
